title: Green strategy for recycling spent all-solid-state sodium-ion batteries and kitchen waste using biomass-based vegetable-/fruit-derived solvents
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00027K, Paper
Yu Chen, Ziteng Yang, Mengxi Zhao, Xihou Wang, Dexin Dong, Zihang Niu, Jiayi Dong, Zheng Li
Vegetable-/fruit-derived solvents (VFSs) are used to simultaneously recycle spent SIBs and kitchen waste.
